title: Consultor de Vendas
description:
O Consultor de Vendas vai realizar o atendimento aos clientes na concessionária, apresentando as motocicletas Yamaha, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre modelos, características técnicas, condições comerciais, financiamento e consórcios.

Entre suas principais atividades estão:

Realizar o atendimento presencial, por telefone e por canais digitais;

Apresentar os modelos de motocicletas Yamaha, destacando diferenciais e benefícios;

Importante ter habilidade para negociação: preços, prazos e condições de pagamento;

Auxiliar o cliente com documentação e processos de financiamento;

Cumprir metas de vendas e indicadores de desempenho estabelecidos pela gerência;

Manter-se atualizado sobre os lançamentos da marca e da concorrência.

Desejável: ter trabalhado, no mínimo, 3 anos em uma mesma empresa e com vendas, preferencialmente, ter passado por cargo de gerência.

Carga Horária:
2ª a 6ª de 09h às 18h e Sábados de 10h às 14h.
Não trabalhamos domingos e feriados.

Local de trabalho: Pechincha ou Barra da Tijuca.

Tipo de vaga: Tempo integral, Efetivo CLT

Pagamento: R$4.000,00 - R$7.000,00 por mês

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Vale-alimentação
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte

Pergunta(s) de seleção:

  • Reside em que bairro?

  • Qual tempo maximo já trabalhou em uma mesma empresa?

  • No ultimo ano qual tem sido o valor mensal da sua media de rendimento?

Local do trabalho: Presencial

title: Intern- Rio
description:
ABS Interns are integrated into ABS business operations and will experience various aspects of engineering review, technical problem solving, and/or research and development. Interns will work with a designated advisor to learn and develop skills relating to ABS's core business functions while also assisting ABS with key deliverables. It is expected that interns will be assigned multiple projects for their respective departments throughout the course of their internship. Interns will work at the local ABS Consulting Office. 

What You Will Do:

  • The primary function of an intern is to develop skills and knowledge of ABS core business functions including but not limited to:
    • Engineering Plan Review.
    • Technical Plan Review.
    • Research and Product Development.
    • Operational Safety and Evaluation.
    • Data Science and Digital Services
  • Interns may provide engineering support in the form of design review and analysis assignments typically involving a major project or several smaller, less complex projects. Projects will vary in complexity and difficulty.
  • Under the supervision of an experienced engineer or engineering manager, interns may assist with a detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure that the needs of the clients will be met.
  • May propose technical advice to field operations and other technical offices.
  • May propose new approaches to problems encountered and make recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or designs.
  • May assist in the development of business performance metrics including the development and implementation of an ongoing business performance monitoring program, and the periodic analysis of operating results to determine causes, trends, etc.
  • May assist with the writing and presentation of technical papers and reports concerning areas of expertise and work performed.
  • May assist with Rule development projects as assigned.
  • Interns may collaborate with the digital team and with other departments such as services, class, project management, commercial operations, etc.
  • Intern may assist with data collection efforts for data quality improvement, in both existing and new data streams to support overall business goals.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in progress in Chemical Engineering (other related Engineering degrees – e.g., Mechanical, Production, Safety, Process – may be considered).
  • Currently enrolled from the 6th semester (or equivalent) onwards.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong interest in risk analysis, process safety and process engineering, especially in sectors such as marine/offshore, oil & gas and mining.
  • Availability to work 30 hours per week (e.g., 6 hours per day, Monday to Friday), during business hours.
  • Intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) – especially Excel for data treatment and KPI/risk indicator analysis.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English (and Portuguese).
  • Organization, attention to detail and interest in quality, risk and safety from a systems and process perspective.
  • Analytical mindset and genuine interest in working with data, engineering information and risk scenarios.
  • Proactivity and curiosity to understand client processes, technologies and risk scenarios in marine/offshore, oil & gas, mining and other industrial sectors.
  • Attention to detail and rigor in technical documentation, records and analyses.
  • Teamwork and collaboration, with ability to interact with multidisciplinary technical teams (engineering, operations, safety, quality, etc.).
  • Good organizational skills to manage multiple analytical tasks and deadlines.
  • Ethical behavior, focus on safety and alignment with ABS values of integrity and responsibility.

It would be nice if you had: 

  • Academic or extracurricular experience related to process safety, risk assessment, reliability, process simulation or industrial operations.
  • Basic understanding of risk analysis methods (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP, Bow-tie, LOPA, FMEA) and/or management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO – even if only from university courses.
  • Familiarity with process flowcharts, PFDs, P&IDs and basic process engineering concepts (mass/energy balance, unit operations, etc.).
  • Experience with spreadsheets and basic data analysis (advanced Excel, simple dashboards, basic BI tools) is a plus.

Reporting Relationships:

You'll work alongside engineer colleagues reporting into a Senior Manager. colleguages 

Important: This internship does not involve laboratory activities. It is a position focused on theoretical and analytical work, risk and process evaluation, data analysis and technical documentation.

title: Engineer II, Sustainability
description:
The Engineer II, Sustainability will be responsible for supporting the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. These include but are not limited to benchmarking, statistical analysis, and sustainability reporting.

What You Will Do:

  • Maintain a solid understanding of emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions and waste streams
  • Support the department's different projects, services, and other activities.
  • Interact with clients to perform services offered by the Global Sustainability team and identify/resolve problems with technical expertise.
  • Establish and manage client projects.
  • May update and inform the Global Sustainability team on regulatory changes and their impact on ABS business.
  • May conduct seminars and workshops related to the environmental performance of marine vessels and offshore units.
  • Support the associated service delivery across all geographic locations of Sustainability (Houston, Athens, Copenhagen, Singapore).
  • May contribute to authoring ABS publications and thought leadership documents. 
  • Maintain awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate
  • May attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends
  • Communicates the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure the needs of the clients will be met
  • May identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company's CRM
  • Works as a team member within the group, but may work autonomously most of the time

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Requires a BSc in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on environmental performance.
  • MSc degree preferred.
  • Requires a minimum of four (4) years of related engineering experience in a recognized research university, research institute, shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society. 
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience with either marine or offshore applications.
  • Knowledge of GHG regulations, impacts, and technology transition.
  • Experience with programming and advanced use of MS Office.
  • Must be capable of presenting and working with clients
  • Knowledge of related technical disciplines required
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills)
  • Ability to work well with others
  • Excellent communication skills (oral & written), enabling effective communication at multiple levels
  • Strong commitment to ethical business practices, in full accordance with relevant corporate policies
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 
  • Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships:

Reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting
description:
Job Description

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients' toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.

  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.

  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.

  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).

  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.

  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.

  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.

  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.

  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.

  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.

  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.

  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.

  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.

  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.

  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack).

  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.

  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates.
Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion )

description:
Descrição da vaga

Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?

Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho: 08:00 às 17:00 sab. 08:00 às 12:00

Oferecemos Ao Novo Colaborador
Refeição no local sem desconto;

Vale transporte;

Cesta básica;

Frequentes processos de seleção interna proporcionando desenvolvimento e o crescimento dos nossos funcionários na empresa;

Parceria pioneira com o SESC com o espaço SESC + SAÚDE, oferecendo serviços gratuitos de odontologia e saúde da mulher (preventivo e mamografia) aos nossos funcionários.

SOBRE NÓS

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como
"A marca mais amada do Rio"
e por 14 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a
"Marca preferida dos Cariocas"
.

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 11 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

title: GIG- Líder de Operações
description:
Descrição da vaga

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país

A
dnata Brasil
opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, a
dnata
foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O
Líder de Operações
ficará responsável por liderar a equipe de operadores de equipamentos e auxiliares de rampa, atuando com assertividade na gestão de pessoas e processos operacionais para promover o desenvolvimento do grupo e do setor, além de garantir aderência da equipe às normas, políticas e procedimentos do departamento e da empresa.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o
Aeroporto do Galeão (GIG)
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar a equipe de operadores de equipamentos e agentes de bagagem e rampa, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional do grupo (formação de sucessores), coordenar as atividades e processos inerentes ao atendimento de aeronaves em solo (chegada e partida), atuando em conjunto com as demais áreas envolvidas na operação visando garantir a pontualidade do voo com qualidade e segurança, segundo as normas e procedimentos publicados no MGO, realizar o procedimento de inspeção visual na fuselagem da aeronave nas chegadas e partidas (walkaround);
  • Coletar, compilar e compartilhar antecipadamente com os demais colaboradores da equipe, dados e informações referentes à operação a ser processada, definir e atribuir responsabilidades ao grupo de trabalho de maneira planejada, analisando a operação "in loco", estabelecendo objetivos de acordo com a priorização de demandas e atividades;
  • Analisar as irregularidades ou situações de risco identificadas, atuando na correção e prevenção através da realização de briefings operacionais e do reporte para demais setores envolvidos;
  • Identificar e reportar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de rampa, seja de maneira micro e/ou macro, realizar briefings operacionais e comportamentais, promover reuniões, dar feedback;
  • Coordenar todas as atividades pertinentes à movimentação de equipamentos de rampa durante o descarregamento e carregamento de bagagens e cargas das aeronaves, orientando os colaboradores durante as operações quanto à logística de atividades, análises de sinistralidades e agindo frente a possíveis ocorrências a fim de evitar rupturas operacionais e perda de qualidade nos serviços executados.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior é um diferencial;
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento intermediário no pacote office;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;
  • Capacidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, locomoção e deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto e para condução do veículo para transportes internos no pátio do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução de veículo a serviço da empresa (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro), suporte à equipe e acompanhamento das atividades operacionais, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

dnata Brasil — faça parte do futuro da aviação.

É quase impossível você andar em um aeroporto no Brasil e não ver o logotipo da
dnata
. Somos um dos maiores hubs da dnata no mundo, atuando em
26 aeroportos
, de norte a sul do país, e em mais de 140 aeroportos em todo o planeta. Sempre em terra, garantindo que cada atendimento aconteça com
segurança, responsabilidade e excelência
.

Aqui, você fará parte de um time com mais de
6.000 profissionais da aviação
, especialistas em
assistência em solo
, atuando desde o
atendimento ao passageiro
, passando
pelo manuseio de bagagens, operações de rampa
e chegando até o
pushback da aeronave,
para a aviação comercial e executiva.

Atendemos
mais de 20 companhias aéreas
e realizamos
mais de 250 mil turnarounds por ano
.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Join the dynamic and collaborative team at Katalyst Data Management (KDM) KDM is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer - OCR with great problem-solving skills who is comfortable working with minimal supervision. This is an exciting opportunity to play an integral role in achieving the company's goals. Qualified candidates will bring a strong knowledge of supervised image classification and open-source technologies to help us address our customer's needs.

  • Located in Barra da Tijuca, Brazil
  • Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., (occasional extended hours to support deployments or maintain service continuity)
  • Full-Time position

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) is the global leader in hosted subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification, to data storage and organisation, to marketing data online, our specialised data services cater to large multinational corporations, national governments and small independents. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment has enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Own the platform, elevate the velocity. The DevOps Engineer is at the center of designing and running our next‑gen hybrid infrastructure, orchestrating application and service migrations to Kubernetes across AWS EKS and on‑prem environments—driving performance, security, and resilience. Partnering closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Software Engineering teams, you'll architect and automate deployments end‑to‑end, lead initiatives that expand our container orchestration, modernize CI/CD pipelines, and standardize provisioning with infrastructure‑as‑code. If you thrive on building scalable platforms that ship faster and safer, this is the role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters across AWS EKS and on-premises environments.
  • Lead migration efforts from AWS ECS to EKS and on-prem Kubernetes platforms.
  • Develop and maintain Terraform modules for infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
  • Implement, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
  • Apply security best practices for containerized applications and Kubernetes cluster configurations.
  • Collaborate with development teams to define standardized application deployment workflows.
  • Monitor system performance and reliability, troubleshoot, and resolve complex infrastructure issues.
  • Contribute to the creation of operational documentation and automate routine tasks to minimize manual intervention.

Knowledge & Skills Required:

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes administration and full cluster lifecycle management.
  • Proficiency in Terraform for implementing Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong background in CI/CD pipeline design and Git-based workflows.
  • Deep understanding of Docker and containerized application architectures.
  • Solid grasp of networking fundamentals, including DNS, routing, load balancing, ingress.
  • Familiarity with observability tools and stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and Open Telemetry.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems and deployment environments effectively.
  • English – Intermediate level – capacity to keep oral conversation with native speakers.

Required Education and Experience:

  1. Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar role.
  3. Proven expertise in managing Kubernetes clusters on a scale, both in cloud and on-premises environments.
  4. Hands-on experience implementing Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time position. As a full-time position, the DevOps Engineer is eligible to participate in benefits coverage offered to Katalyst employees based on geographical location.

Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional extended hours to support deployments or maintain service continuity.

Hybrid work model – three remote days and two on-site days per week.

Travel:

Minimal travel may be required for on-premises infrastructure support, implementation, or occasional team collaboration. If participation in an offsite meeting is requested, all related travel expenses will be covered or reimbursed, in accordance with the company's policies and local regulations.

description:

Responsible for /ensure:

  • All relevant governing documents are adhered to by direct reports.

Other duties are performed as required and/or directed by his/her direct supervisor.

*Responsabilities
RESPONSIBILITIES *

  • Ensure effective use of the Company's Maintenance Management System.
  • Ensure that personnel complete tasks in a safe and efficient manner and comply with all Company policies and regulatory laws and regulations.
  • Assist in planning and coordinating all preventative and corrective maintenance activities in conjunction with other department heads.
  • Assists the Technical Section Leader with all certificates for Class, Flag State and regulatory body requirements.
  • Work with Technical Section Leader and other supervisors to coordinate daily work activities accordingly.
  • Assist the Technical Section Leader to ensure that all Third Party equipment is fit for purpose, certified,
  • correctly installed and maintained while on the rig.
  • Ensure that reports for repair and maintenance of equipment are accurate and complete.
  • Ensure that the permit to work and isolation systems are strictly adhered to by the maintenance department.
  • Assist the drilling department with repair and maintenance of drilling equipment as required.
  • Perform maintenance of all the unit's systems including the piping system according to the maintenance program.
  • Assist the electrical department with repair and maintenance of electrical equipment as required.
  • Ensure technical inventory is maintained within budget and at operating levels.
  • Ensure equipment is maintained as per Seadrill and manufacturer's specifications.
  • Assist other departments to ensure first line maintenance is performed effectively.
  • Develop and promote effective troubleshooting condition evaluation and root cause failure analysis programs for all technical equipment.
  • Promote and develop maintenance task optimization and provide feedback to technical team. Follow up and implement approved changed to SAMS.
  • Maintain a working relationship with the Client representatives.
  • Perform or lead incident investigation as required.
  • Ensure technical inventory is maintained within budget and at operating levels
  • Assist with coordinating management of change for design modification of equipment and within technical area;
  • Liaise with shore based technical staff to ensure a timely transfer of knowledge within the fleet.
  • Liaise with the marine department regarding the loading, ordering and use of fuel, lubes, potable water and drill water.
  • Assist with classification surveys as part of continuous machinery survey and any other applicable requirements.
  • Assist Technical Section Leader with budget preparation.
  • Mentor, develop and train crew members to ensure they are competent to work in their current job positions and where appropriate coached and prepared for the next position.
  • Ensure that approved rig operating procedures are adhered to at all times. Report all unsafe activities, situations, and potential hazards to supervisor.
  • Actively participate in safety, departmental, pre-tour, client meetings, etc.
  • Actively participate in the Safety Management Systems.
  • Ensure housekeeping is maintained in assigned areas.
  • Effectively use all safety and environmental tools employed by Seadrill (5-point check, STAR cards, PTW etc.).
  • Perform all emergency duties as per designation on the station bill and emergency response plans.
  • Comply with the training matrix for the position.
  • Comply with the Competence Assurance Program in a timely manner as per Seadrill requirement.
  • Conduct performance appraisals for subordinates. Recommend promotion, development or disciplinary action.
  • Follow maintenance policy as specified by the Company at all times.
  • Review and, as required, perform all safety control duties as per rig´s specific HSE Case, Safety Case, HAZOP and TBRA´s.
  • Review and, as required, perform all duties related to safety controls among all tasks performed by himself and or working group.
  • Perform, respecting any applicable license limitation and under supervision, similar responsibilities as the Technical Leader, Engine Room Operator or Assistant Technical Section Leader for training, qualification and temporary coverage purposes.
  • Perform, if required, the same duties as senior mechanic.

*QUALIFICATIONS *
As per Seadrill training and competence directives.

*Minimum Requirements For The Role: *

  • Be able to communicate both in Portuguese and English
  • High School Technical diploma in Mechanic with professional register valid (CFT Ativo)
  • Previous experience within the function
  • Previous experience in Drilling Companies
  • Valid certificates: CBSP, THUET, NR13, etc.

Through strong leadership and personal responsibility from all employees, we take a systematic approach to identifying, managing and preventing the hazards involved in our day to day operations.

Nothing is more important to us than the health, safety and security of our workforce and the communities in which we operate and behaving responsibly towards our shared environment.

We are vigilant, disciplined and always looking out for one another. We have developed and embedded a strong safety culture onshore and offshore, fostered by all employees, who each have a personal responsibility and the authority to put an immediate stop to the job if they believe it to be unsafe.

Everyone at Seadrill is accountable for helping to build this culture of care. This includes:

  • Compliance with the Seadrill Code of Conduct and Fight Against Corruption.
  • Compliance with applicable internal and external governing requirements.
  • Non-compliances are promptly acted on and reported to the direct supervisor.
  • The standard for tidiness and cleanness is adhered to.

SEADRILL BEHAVIORAL FRAMEWORK

title: Junior Commercial Associates
description:
We're Hiring: Junior Commercial Associates ( Entry Level role)

About the Role

OnSpot Travel Solutions is looking for a junior-level, commercially curious professional to support hotel participation in predefined commercial campaigns.
This role is ideal for early-career candidates or those transitioning into sales/commercial roles who want to build strong fundamentals in outbound outreach, commercial conversations, and CRM discipline—within a highly structured and supportive environment.
You will work from clearly defined scripts, campaigns, and processes, engaging with hotel contacts, collecting decisions, and escalating complex questions to senior team members when needed.

Role Summary

Support hotel participation in predefined commercial campaigns by conducting outbound outreach, presenting standardized value propositions, validating interest, and ensuring clear follow-up and documentation.
Success in this entry level commercial role comes from consistency, organization, and coachability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct outbound calls and emails to hotel contacts using predefined messaging

  • Present OnSpot and campaign opportunities clearly and confidently

  • Validate hotel interest in predefined commercial offers

  • Capture responses and guide conversations toward a clear yes / no / follow-up outcome

  • Follow up consistently according to guidelines and timelines

  • Escalate pricing, contractual, or technical questions to senior team members

  • Maintain accurate CRM records (calls, notes, outcomes, next steps)

  • Keep an organized pipeline and respect follow-up SLAs

  • Collaborate with internal teams when support is needed

  • Share market feedback and observations with the team

  • Meet daily and weekly activity targets while following process and quality standards

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent in English and French (additional languages are a plus)

  • Comfortable speaking on the phone and writing professional emails

  • Interest in sales, hospitality, or commercial roles

  • Entry-level to early-career experience in customer service, sales, call centers, hospitality, or similar environments

  • Coachable mindset and willingness to follow structured processes

  • Ability to handle basic objections with guidance

  • Comfortable working toward clear activity targets

  • Strong organization and attention to detail

  • Basic computer skills and willingness to learn CRM tools (Salesforce experience is a plus but not required)

KPIs (Training-Aligned):

Activity: calls made, emails sent, follow-ups completed

Process: CRM accuracy, documentation quality, escalation compliance

Outcome: campaign validations supported

Quality: adherence to scripts, tone, and internal guidelines

Why Join Us:

  • Entry point into commercial and sales roles within hospitality

  • Strong structure, predefined campaigns, and hands-on coaching

  • Learn outbound sales fundamentals in a real business environment

  • Exposure to international hospitality markets

  • Clear expectations, support, and growth opportunities

Requirements

  • Reliable availability and punctuality

  • Stable internet connection

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. Expect structured mentorship, meaningful ownership, and hands‑on experience with projects ranging from spatial data tools to specialized oil & gas solutions—think seismic and well data visualization/manipulation and web‑scraping pipelines—where advanced technology meets complex business challenges. title: Customs & International Freight Manager
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


This role will be responsible for customs operations to ensure compliant, cost-effective, and timely international and domestic movement of goods by managing customs brokerage, documentation, and logistics partnerships. throughout the preparation of the tournament. Will act as the primary liaison for import/export compliance, mitigating risk, resolving transport delays, and optimizing shipping routes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Compliance and Regulations: Ensuring all cargo meets local and international customs laws, regulations, and tax requirements to avoid delays.
  • Logistics and Freight Management: Overseeing transportation, negotiating with carriers/forwarders for optimal rates, and managing shipment tracking.
  • Risk Mitigation and Problem Solving: Proactively addressing issues in the supply chain, such as cargo damage or shipping delays.
  • Operational Support: Coordinating with internal teams (warehouse, procurement) and external partners (ports, agents) to ensure efficient delivery of goods.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education:Engineering, Administration, Economics, International relations or other related areas
  • Experience: minimum 5 years experience in customs and freight in Brazil.
  • Collaborative mindset, adaptable and willing to work to tight and changing timelines.
  • Proficient in analytical thinking and data skills.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude, patience, persistence, and determination.
  • Experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Preparar para terminar e concluir Operações Marítimas e de Cargas, e manter monitoramento do mangote de Offload;
  • Responsável pela operação e monitoramento dos painéis na Sala de Controle referente às Operações de Carga em geral;
  • Responsável por executar o plano de carregamento dos tanques e o plano de descarregamento para as operações de Offload, bem como a consolidação da carga, mantendo as condições de estabilidade do ativo;
  • Manter o Superintendente de Marinha e o Supervisor de Carga informados sobre todas as atividades marítimas, tais como operações de carga, transferência de carga, operações de lastro, etc;
  • Responsável pela manutenção dos procedimentos operacionais e Check lists da abrangência ao controle de carga.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica em áreas correlatas à operação marítima, como Técnico em Marinha Mercante ou Operações Offshore, com conhecimento aplicado em estabilidade de navios e controle de carga;
  • Conhecimento das normas ISM, MARPOL e SOLAS, além de familiaridade com os procedimentos de HSEQ e segurança operacional;
  • Capacidade de operar painéis de controle e sistemas de lastro com autonomia, utilizando ferramentas digitais e checklists operacionais;
  • Inglês técnico intermediário para comunicação operacional e interpretação de instruções técnicas.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?
Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas

Dica:
Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo

Somos um restaurante de cozinha oriental que traz o conceito japa fusion. Fazemos parte do Grupo Trigo, uma holding 100% brasileira, que nasceu com o propósito de democratizar a boa culinária. Além do Gurumê, o Grupo Trigo conta também com as marcas Spoleto, Koni e LeBonton nesta empreitada

O Gurumê foi idealizado com base em quatro grandes pilares: Ambiente; Serviço; Preço e Qualidade. Abrimos nosso primeiro restaurante em 2014 no São Conrado Fashion Mall, com o objetivo de servir uma comida de alta qualidade a um preço acessível. No início de 2017, abrimos nossa segunda casa no coração de Ipanema, com um ambiente descontraído e aconchegante. Em Novembro do mesmo ano, inauguramos nosso terceiro restaurante, desta vez na Tijuca, um dos bairros mais antigos e tradicionais do Rio de Janeiro. Em Fevereiro de 2018, abrimos nosso quarto restaurante no Rio Design Barra. Em 2019 inauguramos nossa quinta casa no Shopping Rio Sul e no finalzinho de 2020, ainda no bairro de Botafogo, nos reinventamos com uma loja 100% Delivery, o Gurumê em Casa.

Ta achando que acabou? Nada disso... O Gurumê está cada vez maior, e com isso apresentamos a nossa mais nova casa, inaugurada em Maio de 2023: Gurumê Rio Design Leblon.

title: Pessoa Estagiário
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoio na análise de projetos de lojas, quiosques e eventos;
  • Acompanhar obras e elaborar relatórios, auxiliando na verificação de conformidades;
  • Acompanhar a rotina de ambiência e paisagismo do shopping;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de projetos internos de arquitetura, estudos de melhorias internas;
  • Contribuir com as rotinas administrativas e financeiras da área de ambiência

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Cursando Arquitetura e Urbanismo (a partir do 4º período, preferencial);
  • Conhecimento intermediário em AutoCad;
  • Desejável conhecimento em SketchUp;
  • Paco Office básico/intermediário.

Informações adicionais

O Que Temos Para Você

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Welhub;
  • Day Off Aniversário;
  • Acolhe (serviço de apoio psicossocial);

  • Saber Online (plataforma interna de aprendizagem).

  • Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro.

  • Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial
  • Escala: 5X2

Existimos para conectar as pessoas com o que importa, servindo e encantando todos os dias e criando momentos que transformam.

Em um mundo em constante evolução, emergimos como uma poderosa força de transformação. Um legado com cerca de 50 anos de experiência que transformou o varejo no Brasil e consolidou uma trajetória de excelência e confiança, estabelecendo-nos como referência no mercado, com um portfólio de 59 shoppings presentes nas cinco regiões do Brasil.

Nossos shoppings são destinos vibrantes, repletos de oportunidades para empreendedores e marcas inovadoras. Com mais de lojas que atraem mais de 54 milhões de visitas por mês, criamos espaços acolhedores, seguros e inspiradores, onde cada visita se torna uma jornada de descoberta e conexão.

Criamos experiências físicas e digitais que transcendem as expectativas dos consumidores e geram impacto positivo na sociedade, com visão de longo prazo e resultados sustentáveis para lojistas e parceiros.

Clique aqui para mais informações sobre como seus dados pessoais na condição de Pessoa Candidata são tratados pela ALLOS.

DIVERSIDADE, EQUIDADE E INCLUSÃO

A ALLOS está comprometida com a criação e fomento de um ambiente de trabalho diverso, que acolha pessoas de raças, etnias, gêneros, origens, vivências e perfis variados, priorizando a inclusão social, a redução das desigualdades e práticas empregatícias justas, que promovam a igualdade de oportunidades.

Esperamos que todos os colaboradores, de qualquer cargo ou hierarquia, sintam-se acolhidos e se orientem pelo respeito mútuo.

As nossas vagas são destinadas para pessoas de diferentes grupos, incluindo mulheres, pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência ou demais grupos sub-representados.

title: Pedreiro/Oficial de Manutenção
description:
Quem somos?

  • Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

Um Oficial de Manutenção Pedreiro experiente, responsável pela execução autônoma de atividades de construção, conservação e reparo. Este profissional terá um papel crucial na manutenção da integridade estrutural e estética de nossos ativos.

Dia a Dia:

O profissional irá realizar tarefas que exigem conhecimento técnico e autonomia, incluindo:

  • Alvenaria e Revestimentos: Assentar tijolos, blocos e construir/reformar instalações em alvenaria.
    Assentar pisos, azulejos e outros revestimentos. Executar emboço e reboco de paredes, garantindo acabamento de qualidade.
  • Reparos Estruturais e Civis: Realizar manutenção e reparos em telhados, lajes, calçadas e outras estruturas.
  • Manutenções Complementares: Executar pequenas tarefas de manutenção hidráulica e elétrica básica (reparos em sistemas de água, instalações elétricas simples), conforme a necessidade.
  • Preparo de Materiais: Preparar argamassas, concretos e outros materiais de construção na dosagem correta.
  • Segurança e Organização: Montar e desmontar andaimes, seguindo rigorosas normas de segurança (NR-35 - Trabalho em Altura). Utilizar todos os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e seguir as normas de segurança, inclusive em espaços confinados.

Local de trabalho: Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário: 8h as 18h de segunda a quinta-feira | 8h as 17h na sexta-feira

O que precisamos que você tenha:

  • 2º grau completo.

O que vamos amar se você tiver:

  • Proatividade e Iniciativa: Capacidade de antecipar problemas e buscar soluções de forma autônoma.
  • Assiduidade: Comprometimento com horários e prazos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de interagir e colaborar efetivamente com outros setores de manutenção.

Benefícios

Benefícios

  • Mobilidade: Cartão Swile com VT (combo mobilidade) para você escolher a melhor forma de chegar ao trabalho.
  • Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.
  • Saúde: Plano de saúde, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico Odontoprev e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico e mental.
  • Finanças: Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento.

  • Descontos exclusivos nos produtos que você já ama: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty.
  • Ambiente que estimula a criatividade e o aprendizado contínuo, com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio do nosso Programa de Educação Continuada — incluindo subsídios para cursos de aperfeiçoamento, graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.
  • Parcerias com instituições de ensino e idiomas, como Estácio e Open English, para facilitar ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados, valorizando quem cresce e constrói junto com a gente.

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, em 2024 a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

title: Event Logistics Coordinator
description:
Event Logistics Coordinator


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


This role will ensure the seamless planning and execution of supply chain operations for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 tournament. Will be responsible for material planning, operations planning, procedures and liaison with other Functional areas.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Logistics Planning: Design and implement end-to-end supply chain strategies for host city venues.
  • Operational Control: Coordinate warehouse management, material handling, and asset tracking (e.g., equipment for stadiums and training sites).
  • Stakeholder Management: Work with Host Cities, Official Logistics Service Providers (LSPs), and FIFA functional areas to align on requirements.
  • Risk Mitigation: Maintain risk registers and develop contingency plans for logistical challenges.
  • Reporting: Monitor KPIs for logistics, policies and procedures

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education: Engineering, Administration, Economics, International relations or other related areas.
  • Experience: minimum 5 years experience in material planning, logistics and procurement.
  • Collaborative mindset, adaptable and willing to work to tight and changing timelines.
  • Proficient in analytical thinking and data skills.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude, patience, persistence, and determination.
  • Experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in IT tools (excel and others)
  • Excelent knowledge in AI
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting
description:
Job Description

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients' toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates.
Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion )

title: Mechanical Technician III
description:
Role Summary:

Mechanical Technician is responsible for the dismantle, clean, and inspect processes of all pumps (repair or upgrade) and decoking equipment. In this role the Mechanical Technician will utilize precision inspection equipment to measure dimensions of components and assemblies. The Mechanical Technician will also repair and assemble equipment meeting quality standards, company policies, and on-time delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Follow instructions given in pre-job briefings and complete all checklists, routers, and procedures.

  • Clean each part to be reused and documenting the condition of components.

  • Use hand torches and liquid nitrogen when appropriate in the teardown process.

  • Disassemble products to repair or replace defective materials or worn parts and make other repairs, as necessary.

  • Inspect components and assemblies accurately and precisely, and clearly record the results of these inspections.

  • Remove visible dirt, grit oil, grease, and other foreign matter from pump product parts, prior to assembly.

  • Frequently apply primer and finish coatings to the exterior of pump products and parts using spray equipment.

  • Operate various precision measuring tools.

  • Take pictures to document condition and process.

  • Participate and adhere to the implementation and use of appropriate reporting and operating systems, manufacturing, and quality processes.

  • Participate and report quality related problems. Report deviations, ensure creation of Non-Conformity Reports and execute corrective actions identified.

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with production planners and customers to discuss the component and pump conditions

  • Coordinate and interface with sales, operations, engineers, and customers as necessary.

  • Exhibit behavior that encourages teambuilding, decision-making, problem solving and continuous improvement.

  • Experience as a rotating machinery mechanic.

  • Must have personal set of mechanic's tools, micrometers, and roll-around toolbox.

  • Able to stand for long periods and lift objects up to 50 lbs.

  • Must be able to work overtime hours including weekends and holidays.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • Pump repair experience.

  • Previous experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience with pumps or heavy machinery.

  • HS Diploma / GED and 5-7 years relevant experience

title: Accounting & Payroll Specialist (QuickBooks, AP/AR) — Remote
description:
About the Client

PromptPeople is hiring for a fast-growing, high-performance services business supporting enterprise clients in the U.S. The company is scaling quickly and needs a finance operator who can take ownership of the day-to-day accounting workflow, keep the books clean, and bring structure to finance operations.

This is a hands-on role. We're looking for someone plug-and-play who can run end-to-end accounting tasks and keep things organized without constant oversight.

Why This Role Exists

The business needs someone to own finance operations end-to-end: AP, AR, invoicing in QuickBooks, payroll processing support, Excel-based reporting, and monthly close tasks. The goal is to reduce bottlenecks, keep finance predictable, and give leadership clean visibility.

What You'll Own (Responsibilities)

AP / AR + day-to-day accounting

  • Own accounts payable and receivable workflows end-to-end

  • Send invoices from QuickBooks, track collections, and follow up on aging AR

  • Process vendor bills, manage payments, and keep AP organized and accurate

  • Maintain clean records and documentation across transactions

Payroll coordination

  • Support payroll processing (including time adjustments, validations, and accuracy checks)

  • Maintain payroll-related documentation and ensure inputs are consistent and clean

Monthly reporting + close support

  • Prepare monthly financial reports for leadership

  • Support monthly close tasks and ensure books are updated and accurate

  • Keep reconciliations organized and up to date (bank and key accounts as needed)

Excel operations

  • Work comfortably in Excel (data cleanup, formatting, transposing datasets, building recurring reports)

  • Turn messy inputs into usable reporting for finance and leadership

Structure + workflow improvement (light systems)

  • Create simple checklists, templates, and repeatable workflows to reduce errors

  • Improve consistency and clarity across finance operations (without needing to "build a full finance org")

What Success Looks Like

First 30–60 days

  • Invoicing, collections, and bill pay are running consistently

  • Payroll adjustments and validations are handled reliably

  • Finance data is organized, up to date, and easy to audit internally

  • Leadership receives clean monthly reporting on time

3–6 months

  • Finance workflows are standardized with checklists and clear routines

  • AR/AP performance improves (fewer misses, cleaner tracking, faster follow-ups)

  • Monthly reporting and close tasks are predictable and low-friction

Requirements

  • Proven experience owning end-to-end accounting operations (AP + AR)

  • Comfortable running finance workflows inside QuickBooks (invoicing, bills, tracking)

  • Payroll processing experience (or strong exposure + ability to own validations/adjustments)

  • Strong Excel skills (including working with messy datasets; transposing / reporting)

  • High attention to detail and ability to work independently without babysitting

  • Excellent English communication (written + verbal)

Nice to Have

  • Experience in service businesses with payroll-heavy operations

  • Exposure to monthly close routines and basic accrual concepts

  • Familiarity with tools like Ramp or AP automation platforms

  • Multi-state / U.S. operations exposure (nice to have, not required)

Benefits

  • 100% remote

  • USD compensation

  • PTO (paid time off)

  • Local holidays

  • Direct work with the leadership team

  • High ownership and autonomy

  • Fast-paced environment with real impact

  • Growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Software Engineer, Backend
description:
Ready to be pushed beyond what you think you're capable of?

At Coinbase, our mission is to increase economic freedom in the world. It's a massive, ambitious opportunity that demands the best of us, every day, as we build the emerging onchain platform — and with it, the future global financial system.

To achieve our mission, we're seeking a very specific candidate. We want someone who is passionate about our mission and who believes in the power of crypto and blockchain technology to update the financial system. We want someone who is eager to leave their mark on the world, who relishes the pressure and privilege of working with high caliber colleagues, and who actively seeks feedback to keep leveling up. We want someone who will run towards, not away from, solving the company's hardest problems.

Our work culture is intense and isn't for everyone. But if you want to build the future alongside others who excel in their disciplines and expect the same from you, there's no better place to be.

While many roles at Coinbase are remote-first, we are not remote-only. In-person participation is required throughout the year. Team and company-wide offsites are held multiple times annually to foster collaboration, connection, and alignment. Attendance is expected and fully supported.

About the team

The Consumer Product Group engineers strive to make the Coinbase retail app the easiest-to-use and fastest experience for accessing the crypto.

The Coinbase Brazil team is focused on driving our operations and growth strategy across the country. We collaborate cross-functionally to launch features tailored to the Brazilian market, run localized marketing campaigns, and ensure the Coinbase experience meets the expectations of Brazilian users. We aim to expand Coinbase's presence in Brazil by delivering impactful features and experiences designed for local users. From payment integrations to promotional efforts, our goal is to make Coinbase the platform of choice for Brazilians entering the world of crypto. Compliance plays a key role in our work. The team is committed to identifying and mitigating risks that could affect the business, while continuously improving our processes to align with Brazilian regulatory standards. Whether it's optimizing KYC flows or refining internal operations, we're building for long-term trust and sustainability in the Brazilian market.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, implement, and maintain robust backend systems and APIs that power Coinbase products for Brazilian users.
  • Own the development of server-side features that directly drive revenue and enhance user experiences.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, product managers, and designers to build scalable, end-to-end solutions.
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and security in compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements.
  • Solve complex, large-scale technical challenges related to distributed systems, databases, and microservices architecture.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested code that meets the needs of users and internal stakeholders.

What We Look for in You

  • 2+ years of experience developing backend systems and APIs using languages such as Python, Java, Go, or
  • Strong understanding of server-side architecture best practices, including performance optimization, security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Experience integrating with databases, caching layers, and other storage solutions.
  • Proven ability to design and implement complex business logic in a reliable and efficient manner.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, microservices, and containerized environments (e.g., AWS, Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Experience collaborating across product and engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Commitment to writing high-quality, well-tested code that serves real customer needs.
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Nice to Haves

  • Experience as a Full Stack Developer.
  • Experience with cryptocurrency, blockchain, or fintech platforms.

Job #: P75239

*Answers to crypto-related questions may be used to evaluate your onchain experience.

description:

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Coordenar o processo de projeção mensal de Capex e/ou Opex;  
  • Elaborar relatório mensal de aderência orçamentária dos projetos de investimentos e da portfólio;  
  • Elaborar material ref. ao controle de investimentos e de gastos operacionais para reunião de análise crítica/resultados;  
  • Gerir informações e justificativas de planejamento x realização;  
  • Gerir os projetos da gerência no sistema SAP (criar e estruturar as definições dos projetos, etc.);  
  • Realizar o acompanhamento mensal e consolidar as informações de justificativas de desvios dos projetos considerando a realização até o mês corrente e a previsão para o ano corrente;  
  • Fiscalizar e orientar as áreas de projetos sobre o correto enquadramento das classes de justificativas dos desvios conforme orientação corporativa;  
  • Elaborar relatório de evolução dos projetos de investimento, com análises orçamentárias e qualitativas, informações de aspecto legal e gerencial;  
  • Conduzir o processo de apontamento de horas e orientar quanto aos procedimentos e prazos;  
  • Conduzir o processo anual e mensal de planejamento de OAI;  
  • Realizar, analisar e validar os gastos para o RGT (Relatório de Gastos Trimestrais);  
  • Realizar apontamento de horas dos empregados do ativo no SAP;  
  • Elaborar material para reunião de análise crítica dos indicadores de gastos e resultados das gerências;  
  • Gerir informações e justificativas de planejamento x realização de horas-extras dos empregados das gerências;  
  • Gerir os projetos da gerência no sistema SAP (criar e estruturar a EAP, informar objetos corretos para alocação de gastos, sanear e bloquear os objetos, emitir CEOP, etc.);  
  • Realizar a validação e acerto dos objetos de custos informados nas requisições de transporte offshore de pessoas e cargas;  
  • Prover informações, análises de baixa a média complexidade e esclarecimentos sobre os gastos analisados para partes interessadas e/ou em processos de parcerias;  
  • E outras atividades similares de mesma complexidade e escopo.  

Sobre a CAPCO:

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. 
Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupo de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros.
